'''DUM-4''' was a [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droid]] produced by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] at some point prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. DUM-4 was part of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] pool maintained at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], along with [[DUM-9]].

==History==
DUM-4, along with his fellow pit droids, were put to work during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Like most pit droids, DUM-4 was not too clever, and he would often fight with others. He seemed to particularly enjoy working with the young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="APD" /> despite being officially assigned to [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell's]] pit.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:DUM-4.png|thumb|left|DUM-4 watching the race]]
Prior to the race, DUM-4 was called upon to locate a power plug for Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]]. The droid ran to [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano's]] pit and asked for one, and the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] racer promised he would provide a plug in exchange for a thrust cone. DUM-4 was sent to [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba's]] pit to ask for the cone. Once again, the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] refused to hand out the part without compensation. He tasked DUM-4 with the delivery of a private message to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], and insisted on getting the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] written answer. While some pilots were flying practice laps, the pit droid reached [[Jabba's private box]] and he held out Sebulba's note. The pit droid then made all his deliveries, and got the part to Anakin just in time, five minutes before the beginning of the race.<ref name="APD" />

After the race began, DUM-4 remained at the pit stop to help repair any damaged Podracers. However, while attempting to correct an engine failure on Ody Mandrell's [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]], the little droid was sucked into the [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. He destroyed the entire engine, costing Mandrell the race, although DUM-4 survived the accident, coming out of the engine, blackened and scorched, but laughing hysterically.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: I Am a Droid (Random House)|''Star Wars: I Am a Droid'']] and ''[[Anakin's Fate]]'' both indicate that DUM-4 was a series of pit droids, not an individual unit.

Jon Knowles stated in the Episode I DVD commentaries that DUM-4 and his two fellow pit droids were based in part on the Three Stooges. The name is a reference to the word "dumb".
